meta.title: Contact
meta.description: Questions? Write to PacerGo support and our Taiwan team will reply as soon as we can.

hero.sub: Bookings, accounts, becoming a workout partner, safety concerns - email us about anything. Our Taiwan team will reply as soon as we can.

topics.title: Tell us what it's about
topics.sub: Pick a topic and we'll pre-fill the subject line so your email reaches the right person.

account.label: Account & sign-in
account.desc: Can't sign in, update details, or delete your account.

companion.subject: [PacerGo] Workout partner / review question

safety.label: Report a safety concern
safety.desc: Report behavior or content that made you feel unsafe.

partner.label: Partnerships & press
partner.desc: Gym alliances, brand partnerships, or interviews.
partner.subject: [PacerGo] Partnership & press inquiry

other.label: Something else
other.desc: None of the above? Write anyway - we read every message.
other.subject: [PacerGo] Support

notes.reply_body: We're a small team in Taiwan and aim to reply within 1-2 business days (Taipei time, Mon-Fri).
notes.safety_body: If something urgent happens during a session, call 110 (police) or 119 (ambulance) first - then tell us by email.
